sections.title: Benchmarking the computational power of quantum computers
sections.abstract: The authors introduce QUOPS, a benchmark for the size and speed of computationally relevant circuits, and apply it across Quantinuum, Google, IBM, and an eight-logical-qubit fault-tolerant processor.
sections.claimed_result: Applying QUOPS suggests that current computational capability must grow by about five orders of magnitude for recognized useful workloads.
sections.caveat: The utility gap depends on selected challenge problems and future fault-tolerant architecture assumptions.

sections.title: Search for a light pseudoscalar Higgs boson in final states with boosted muon pairs and tau lepton pairs in proton-proton collisions at sqrt(s) = 13 TeV
sections.abstract: CMS searches 138 fb^-1 of LHC data for H -> aa -> mumu tautau using dedicated boosted-ditau reconstruction and finds no significant excess.
sections.claimed_result: CMS sets 95% confidence-level upper limits on the exotic Higgs process.
sections.caveat: No excess was observed; limits depend on reconstruction efficiency and systematic modeling.

sections.title: Constraints on Galactic Dark Photons from a DALI Prototype
sections.abstract: Thirty-six hours of DALI haloscope data show no significant dark-photon excess but set a new exclusion constraint in a narrow GHz band.
sections.claimed_result: The analysis reaches chi <= 6.8e-14 at 28.54 microelectronvolts.
sections.caveat: This is a narrow-band null result from 36 hours of data and is conditional on the detector and dark-photon model.

sections.title: Fast BIB simulation at a future Muon Collider with generative machine learning
sections.abstract: Diffusion and circular-spline-flow models generate muon-collider beam-induced-background hits and tracks over an order of magnitude faster than full simulation.
sections.claimed_result: The models approximately reproduce available hit and track distributions while reducing generation time by more than an order of magnitude.
sections.caveat: Evaluation is against simulation rather than collision data, and the faster model trades fidelity for speed.

sections.title: Constraining Ultralight Scalars with Black Hole Binary Mergers in Galactic Nuclei
sections.abstract: Superradiance clouds around spinning black holes can enhance binary capture in galactic nuclei, allowing merger-rate data to probe ultralight scalars.
sections.claimed_result: The work projects sensitivity to ultralight scalars around 4e-14 to 1e-13 eV using low-mass-ratio merger rates.
sections.caveat: Reach depends strongly on black-hole populations, galactic-nucleus demographics, and cloud-binary dynamics.

sections.title: Multiple Majorana zero modes realization based on superconducting topological crystalline metal ZrRuAs
sections.abstract: First-principles calculations and model analysis identify superconducting topological crystalline metal ZrRuAs combined with a ferromagnetic insulator as a candidate platform for two Majorana branches.
sections.claimed_result: The proposed heterostructure can realize BdG Chern number -2 and two symmetry-protected Majorana-zero-mode branches under stated model conditions.
sections.caveat: The platform is a proposal requiring fabrication and experimental verification; interfaces and disorder may change the predicted phase.
